[{"id": "call_62p7dhjv", "function": {"index": 0, "name": "write_file", "arguments": {"content": "def execute(task, jobs):
    # Determine task mode, default to "all"
    task_mode = task.get("mode", "all")
    # If task_mode is None treat as all
    if task_mode is None:
        task_mode = "all"
    result = []
    for job in jobs:
        job_mode = job.get("mode")
        # Unknown job mode (missing or None) is considered compatible with all
        if job_mode is None:
            result.append(job)
            continue
        # If task mode is "all", include all jobs
        if task_mode == "all":
            result.append(job)
        else:
            if job_mode == task_mode:
                result.append(job)
    return result
